title: 鋼構耐火被覆施工
subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety
summary: 從鋼材在火害中的強度折減與臨界溫度出發，建立斷面係數與被覆厚度的熱傳關係，比較噴覆型防火材料（SFRM）與膨脹型防火塗料的材料機制、施工環境與交叉作業損傷，再以 ASTM E605／E736 現場抽驗、耐火試驗登錄與約束條件判讀完成驗收，並以世界貿易中心、紐約時報大樓與馬德里溫莎大樓說明厚度、黏結與改修過渡期的風險。
summaryEn: Starting from steel strength loss and critical temperature in fire, build the heat-transfer link between section factor and protection thickness, compare the mechanisms, site conditions and trade damage of sprayed fire-resistive materials (SFRM) and intumescent coatings, then close acceptance with ASTM E605/E736 field sampling, fire-test listings and restraint classification, using the World Trade Center, the New York Times Building and the Windsor Building in Madrid to show the risks of thin spots, weak bond and half-finished retrofits.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「火害曝露與鋼材強度折減」與「斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fire exposure and steel strength loss" and "Section factor and heating of protected steel": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 火害曝露與鋼材強度折減：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire exposure and steel strength loss: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼構件臨界溫度」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Critical steel temperature” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 結構鋼在約 400°C 以上開始明顯損失降伏強度與彈性模數，600°C 左右只剩常溫強度的一半左右，而一般建築火災的煙層溫度在數十分鐘內即可超過 800°C。耐火被覆本身不承載，它的任務是延緩熱量進入鋼材，使構件在要求的耐火時效內仍低於「臨界溫度」，也就是剩餘強度恰好等於火災時載重效應的溫度。臨界溫度不是固定值：火災載重組合採用較低的活載重，構件利用率越低，可容許的溫度越高；梁柱的支承與約束條件也會改變破壞模式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼構件臨界溫度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Structural steel begins to lose yield strength and stiffness noticeably above about 400°C and keeps only about half its ambient strength near 600°C, while gas temperatures in an ordinary building fire can exceed 800°C within tens of minutes. Fireproofing carries no load; its task is to slow heat flow into the steel so that, for the required fire-resistance period, the member stays below its critical temperature, the temperature at which the remaining strength just equals the load effect in fire. That temperature is not fixed: fire load combinations use reduced live load, a lower utilisation allows a higher temperature, and support and restraint conditions change the failure mode. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Critical steel temperature” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼構件臨界溫度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Critical steel temperature”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 火害曝露與鋼材強度折減
knowledge.titleEn: Fire exposure and steel strength loss
knowledge.text: 結構鋼在約 400°C 以上開始明顯損失降伏強度與彈性模數，600°C 左右只剩常溫強度的一半左右，而一般建築火災的煙層溫度在數十分鐘內即可超過 800°C。耐火被覆本身不承載，它的任務是延緩熱量進入鋼材，使構件在要求的耐火時效內仍低於「臨界溫度」，也就是剩餘強度恰好等於火災時載重效應的溫度。
knowledge.textEn: Structural steel begins to lose yield strength and stiffness noticeably above about 400°C and keeps only about half its ambient strength near 600°C, while gas temperatures in an ordinary building fire can exceed 800°C within tens of minutes. Fireproofing carries no load; its task is to slow heat flow into the steel so that, for the required fire-resistance period, the member stays below its critical temperature, the temperature at which the remaining strength just equals the load effect in fire.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「火害曝露與鋼材強度折減」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire exposure and steel strength loss" is correct?
options: 鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。
結構鋼在約 400°C 以上開始明顯損失降伏強度與彈性模數，600°C 左右只剩常溫強度的一半左右，而一般建築火災的煙層溫度在數十分鐘內即可超過 800°C。
被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。
optionsEn: Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame.

Structural steel begins to lose yield strength and stiffness noticeably above about 400°C and keeps only about half its ambient strength near 600°C, while gas temperatures in an ordinary building fire can exceed 800°C within tens of minutes.
Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section.
quiz.explanation: 結構鋼在約 400°C 以上開始明顯損失降伏強度與彈性模數，600°C 左右只剩常溫強度的一半左右，而一般建築火災的煙層溫度在數十分鐘內即可超過 800°C。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Structural steel begins to lose yield strength and stiffness noticeably above about 400°C and keeps only about half its ambient strength near 600°C, while gas temperatures in an ordinary building fire can exceed 800°C within tens of minutes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 火害曝露與鋼材強度折減：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire exposure and steel strength loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼構件臨界溫度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Critical steel temperature” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EN 1993-1-2 臨界溫度 θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482。利用率 μ₀ = 0.6 時 θ_cr ≈ 554°C；μ₀ = 0.4 時 θ_cr ≈ 620°C。ISO 834 標準升溫 θ_g = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20 在 t = 60 min 時約 945°C，遠高於兩者，因此必須靠被覆延緩升溫。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. A utilisation μ₀ = 0.6 gives θ_cr ≈ 554°C; μ₀ = 0.4 gives θ_cr ≈ 620°C. The ISO 834 standard curve θ_g = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20 reaches about 945°C at t = 60 min, far above both, so protection must delay the heating. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構計算書列出每一類構件在火災載重組合下的利用率並換算臨界溫度，再對照所選耐火試驗登錄的允收溫度（ASTM E119 梁為四點平均 593°C、任一點 704°C）是否一致或較保守；若採性能化設計，需由防火工程師提出升溫分析，並經審查單位與主管建築機關認可。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List each member type's utilisation under the fire load combination in the structural calculations, convert it to a critical temperature, and check that the acceptance temperature of the chosen fire-test listing (ASTM E119 beams: 593°C average over four points, 704°C at any point) is consistent or more conservative; a performance-based design needs a heat-transfer analysis by a fire engineer, accepted by the peer reviewer and the building authority.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: EN 1993-1-2 臨界溫度 θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482。利用率 μ₀ = 0.6 時 θ_cr ≈ 554°C；μ₀ = 0.4 時 θ_cr ≈ 620°C。ISO 834 標準升溫 θ_g = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20 在 t = 60 min 時約 945°C，遠高於兩者，因此必須靠被覆延緩升溫。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. A utilisation μ₀ = 0.6 gives θ_cr ≈ 554°C; μ₀ = 0.4 gives θ_cr ≈ 620°C. The ISO 834 standard curve θ_g = 345·log₁₀(8t+1) + 20 reaches about 945°C at t = 60 min, far above both, so protection must delay the heating. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「火害曝露與鋼材強度折減」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire exposure and steel strength loss", which statement holds?
options: 膨脹型塗料只要總乾膜厚度足夠，底漆與面漆可以任意搭配。
被覆驗收合格之後，後續工班的作業不會影響耐火性能。
optionsEn: As long as the total dry film is thick enough, any primer and topcoat can be paired with an intumescent coating.
Once fireproofing passes acceptance, later trades cannot affect its fire performance.
EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482.
quiz.explanationEn: EN 1993-1-2 gives the critical temperature θ_cr = 39.19·ln[1/(0.9674·μ₀^3.833) − 1] + 482. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 火害曝露與鋼材強度折減：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire exposure and steel strength loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼構件臨界溫度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Critical steel temperature” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構計算書列出每一類構件在火災載重組合下的利用率並換算臨界溫度，再對照所選耐火試驗登錄的允收溫度（ASTM E119 梁為四點平均 593°C、任一點 704°C）是否一致或較保守；若採性能化設計，需由防火工程師提出升溫分析，並經審查單位與主管建築機關認可。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List each member type's utilisation under the fire load combination in the structural calculations, convert it to a critical temperature, and check that the acceptance temperature of the chosen fire-test listing (ASTM E119 beams: 593°C average over four points, 704°C at any point) is consistent or more conservative; a performance-based design needs a heat-transfer analysis by a fire engineer, accepted by the peer reviewer and the building authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計圖應以表格列出每種構件的耐火時效、所依據的試驗登錄編號、利用率假設與所需厚度，並註明「變更斷面或載重須重新核算被覆」；這張表是監造、被覆廠商與檢驗員共同的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings should tabulate for each member type the fire-resistance rating, the listing number relied on, the assumed utilisation and the required thickness, with a note that any change of section or load requires the fireproofing to be re-checked; this table is the common reference for the supervising engineer, applicator and inspector.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有構件一律套用相同被覆厚度而不看利用率與斷面，常造成重載的細長柱保護不足、輕載大梁卻過度保護；火災中保護不足的柱先達臨界溫度並縮短，迫使上方樓層荷重重分配，嚴重時引發連鎖破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying one thickness to every member regardless of utilisation and section often leaves heavily loaded slender columns under-protected and lightly loaded girders over-protected; in a fire the under-protected column reaches its critical temperature first and shortens, forcing load redistribution in the floors above and, at worst, progressive failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在結構計算書列出每一類構件在火災載重組合下的利用率並換算臨界溫度，再對照所選耐火試驗登錄的允收溫度（ASTM E119 梁為四點平均 593°C、任一點 704°C）是否一致或較保守；若採性能化設計，需由防火工程師提出升溫分析，並經審查單位與主管建築機關認可。
knowledge.textEn: List each member type's utilisation under the fire load combination in the structural calculations, convert it to a critical temperature, and check that the acceptance temperature of the chosen fire-test listing (ASTM E119 beams: 593°C average over four points, 704°C at any point) is consistent or more conservative; a performance-based design needs a heat-transfer analysis by a fire engineer, accepted by the peer reviewer and the building authority.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計圖應以表格列出每種構件的耐火時效、所依據的試驗登錄編號、利用率假設與所需厚度，並註明「變更斷面或載重須重新核算被覆」；這張表是監造、被覆廠商與檢驗員共同的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Drawings should tabulate for each member type the fire-resistance rating, the listing number relied on, the assumed utilisation and the required thickness, with a note that any change of section or load requires the fireproofing to be re-checked; this table is the common reference for the supervising engineer, applicator and inspector.

quiz.question: 要驗證「火害曝露與鋼材強度折減」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire exposure and steel strength loss"?
options: 在結構計算書列出每一類構件在火災載重組合下的利用率並換算臨界溫度，再對照所選耐火試驗登錄的允收溫度（ASTM E119 梁為四點平均 593°C、任一點 704°C）是否一致或較保守。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
約束等級的耐火時效一定比非約束等級長，所以都應採用約束等級。
optionsEn: List each member type's utilisation under the fire load combination in the structural calculations, convert it to a critical temperature, and check that the acceptance temperature of the chosen fire-test listing (ASTM E119 beams: 593°C average over four points, 704°C at any point) is consistent or more conservative.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A restrained rating always lasts longer than an unrestrained one, so it should always be used.
quiz.explanation: 在結構計算書列出每一類構件在火災載重組合下的利用率並換算臨界溫度，再對照所選耐火試驗登錄的允收溫度（ASTM E119 梁為四點平均 593°C、任一點 704°C）是否一致或較保守；若採性能化設計，需由防火工程師提出升溫分析，並經審查單位與主管建築機關認可。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List each member type's utilisation under the fire load combination in the structural calculations, convert it to a critical temperature, and check that the acceptance temperature of the chosen fire-test listing (ASTM E119 beams: 593°C average over four points, 704°C at any point) is consistent or more conservative; a performance-based design needs a heat-transfer analysis by a fire engineer, accepted by the peer reviewer and the building authority. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 火害曝露與鋼材強度折減：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire exposure and steel strength loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼構件臨界溫度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Critical steel temperature” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有構件一律套用相同被覆厚度而不看利用率與斷面，常造成重載的細長柱保護不足、輕載大梁卻過度保護；火災中保護不足的柱先達臨界溫度並縮短，迫使上方樓層荷重重分配，嚴重時引發連鎖破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying one thickness to every member regardless of utilisation and section often leaves heavily loaded slender columns under-protected and lightly loaded girders over-protected; in a fire the under-protected column reaches its critical temperature first and shortens, forcing load redistribution in the floors above and, at worst, progressive failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：臨界溫度不是固定值：火災載重組合採用較低的活載重，構件利用率越低，可容許的溫度越高；梁柱的支承與約束條件也會改變破壞模式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That temperature is not fixed: fire load combinations use reduced live load, a lower utilisation allows a higher temperature, and support and restraint conditions change the failure mode.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼材要到熔點（約 1,500°C）才會失去承載力，所以一般火災不足以讓鋼構倒塌。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel only loses capacity near its melting point of about 1,500°C, so an ordinary fire cannot bring down a steel frame." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「火害曝露與鋼材強度折減」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire exposure and steel strength loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把所有構件一律套用相同被覆厚度而不看利用率與斷面，常造成重載的細長柱保護不足、輕載大梁卻過度保護。
被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Applying one thickness to every member regardless of utilisation and section often leaves heavily loaded slender columns under-protected and lightly loaded girders over-protected.
Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Section factor and heating of protected steel: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斷面係數 Ap/V」如何影響鋼構耐火被覆施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section factor Ap/V” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural-steel fireproofing application”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 受火鋼材的升溫速度取決於吸熱表面積與可儲熱鋼材體積之比，也就是斷面係數 Ap/V（美制以每呎重量與受熱周長之比 W/D 表示，意義相反）。同樣的被覆厚度包在薄腹細長斷面上升溫較快，包在厚重斷面上升溫較慢。被覆以低熱傳導係數形成熱阻，熱流大約與厚度成反比；含水的水泥系材料在約 100°C 時還會因水分蒸發出現升溫平台。三面受火（上方為樓板）與四面受火的周長不同，必須依實際構造計算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斷面係數 Ap/V」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The heating rate of protected steel depends on the ratio of heated surface to the steel volume that stores heat, the section factor Ap/V (US practice uses weight per foot over heated perimeter, W/D, the inverse sense). The same protection thickness lets a thin-walled slender section heat faster than a heavy one. The protection forms a thermal resistance with low conductivity, so heat flow is roughly inversely proportional to thickness; moisture in cementitious products also produces a temperature plateau near 100°C as water evaporates. Three-sided exposure under a slab and four-sided exposure give different perimeters and must follow the actual construction. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Section factor Ap/V” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輕質被覆的集總升溫率 Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For light protection the lumped heating rate is Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斷面係數 Ap/V」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Section factor Ap/V”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫
knowledge.titleEn: Section factor and heating of protected steel
knowledge.text: 受火鋼材的升溫速度取決於吸熱表面積與可儲熱鋼材體積之比，也就是斷面係數 Ap/V（美制以每呎重量與受熱周長之比 W/D 表示，意義相反）。同樣的被覆厚度包在薄腹細長斷面上升溫較快，包在厚重斷面上升溫較慢。
knowledge.textEn: The heating rate of protected steel depends on the ratio of heated surface to the steel volume that stores heat, the section factor Ap/V (US practice uses weight per foot over heated perimeter, W/D, the inverse sense). The same protection thickness lets a thin-walled slender section heat faster than a heavy one.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

受火鋼材的升溫速度取決於吸熱表面積與可儲熱鋼材體積之比，也就是斷面係數 Ap/V（美制以每呎重量與受熱周長之比 W/D 表示，意義相反）。
optionsEn: Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section.
Lighter fireproofing always insulates better, so the lowest-density product suits every location.

steps.title: 斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Section factor and heating of protected steel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斷面係數 Ap/V」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Section factor Ap/V” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：輕質被覆的集總升溫率 Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa)。取 λp = 0.12 W/m·K、dp = 25 mm、Ap/V = 150 m⁻¹、θg − θa = 800 K、ca = 600 J/kg·K、ρa = 7,850 kg/m³：(0.12/0.025)×150×800×60 s/(600×7,850) ≈ 7.3 K/min；厚度加倍為 50 mm 時約 3.7 K/min。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For light protection the lumped heating rate is Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa). With λp = 0.12 W/m·K, dp = 25 mm, Ap/V = 150 m⁻¹, θg − θa = 800 K, ca = 600 J/kg·K and ρa = 7,850 kg/m³: (0.12/0.025)×150×800×60 s/(600×7,850) ≈ 7.3 K/min; doubling the thickness to 50 mm gives about 3.7 K/min. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從鋼構深化圖取出每一斷面尺寸，依三面或四面受火計算受熱周長與斷面係數，與廠商厚度表或試驗登錄的適用範圍比對；超出範圍（斷面係數過大或過小）時不可外插，須取得廠商或試驗機構出具的工程判定書。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take each section's dimensions from the steel shop drawings, compute heated perimeter and section factor for three- or four-sided exposure, and compare with the range of the manufacturer's thickness tables or the test listing; outside that range, with a section factor too high or too low, do not extrapolate but obtain an engineering judgement from the manufacturer or test body.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 輕質被覆的集總升溫率 Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa)。取 λp = 0.12 W/m·K、dp = 25 mm、Ap/V = 150 m⁻¹、θg − θa = 800 K、ca = 600 J/kg·K、ρa = 7,850 kg/m³：(0.12/0.025)×150×800×60 s/(600×7,850) ≈ 7.3 K/min；厚度加倍為 50 mm 時約 3.7 K/min。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For light protection the lumped heating rate is Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa). With λp = 0.12 W/m·K, dp = 25 mm, Ap/V = 150 m⁻¹, θg − θa = 800 K, ca = 600 J/kg·K and ρa = 7,850 kg/m³: (0.12/0.025)×150×800×60 s/(600×7,850) ≈ 7.3 K/min; doubling the thickness to 50 mm gives about 3.7 K/min. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Section factor and heating of protected steel", which statement holds?
options: 輕質被覆的集總升溫率 Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa)。
只要噴得夠厚，鋼材表面的油汙或浮鏽不會影響被覆效果。
平均厚度達到設計值，就代表每一處都有足夠的保護。
optionsEn: For light protection the lumped heating rate is Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa).
If it is sprayed thick enough, oil or loose rust on the steel does not affect the protection.
If the average thickness meets the design value, every location is adequately protected.
quiz.explanation: 輕質被覆的集總升溫率 Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For light protection the lumped heating rate is Δθ/Δt ≈ (λp/dp)·(Ap/V)·(θg − θa)/(ca·ρa). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Section factor and heating of protected steel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷面係數 Ap/V」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Section factor Ap/V” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從鋼構深化圖取出每一斷面尺寸，依三面或四面受火計算受熱周長與斷面係數，與廠商厚度表或試驗登錄的適用範圍比對；超出範圍（斷面係數過大或過小）時不可外插，須取得廠商或試驗機構出具的工程判定書。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take each section's dimensions from the steel shop drawings, compute heated perimeter and section factor for three- or four-sided exposure, and compare with the range of the manufacturer's thickness tables or the test listing; outside that range, with a section factor too high or too low, do not extrapolate but obtain an engineering judgement from the manufacturer or test body. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：深化圖階段由鋼構廠輸出每支構件的斷面係數清單，被覆廠商據此提出逐件厚度表並簽章；現場每支構件以噴漆或標籤標示所需厚度，讓施作人員與檢驗員不必在現場自行換算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At shop-drawing stage the steel fabricator issues a section-factor list for every member, the fireproofing contractor returns a signed member-by-member thickness schedule, and each member on site is marked with its required thickness so that applicators and inspectors never recalculate in the field.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把四面受火周長套用到頂部有樓板的梁，或把箱形柱當成 H 型鋼計算，斷面係數算錯會直接造成厚度不足或浪費；另一常見錯誤是忽略蜂巢梁與腹板開孔梁的薄腹板，局部升溫遠快於翼板。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a four-sided perimeter for a beam under a slab, or treating a box column as an H-section, gives a wrong section factor and directly produces too little or wasted thickness; another common error ignores the thin webs of cellular or castellated beams, which heat much faster locally than the flanges. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從鋼構深化圖取出每一斷面尺寸，依三面或四面受火計算受熱周長與斷面係數，與廠商厚度表或試驗登錄的適用範圍比對；超出範圍（斷面係數過大或過小）時不可外插，須取得廠商或試驗機構出具的工程判定書。
knowledge.textEn: Take each section's dimensions from the steel shop drawings, compute heated perimeter and section factor for three- or four-sided exposure, and compare with the range of the manufacturer's thickness tables or the test listing; outside that range, with a section factor too high or too low, do not extrapolate but obtain an engineering judgement from the manufacturer or test body.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 深化圖階段由鋼構廠輸出每支構件的斷面係數清單，被覆廠商據此提出逐件厚度表並簽章；現場每支構件以噴漆或標籤標示所需厚度，讓施作人員與檢驗員不必在現場自行換算。
knowledge.textEn: At shop-drawing stage the steel fabricator issues a section-factor list for every member, the fireproofing contractor returns a signed member-by-member thickness schedule, and each member on site is marked with its required thickness so that applicators and inspectors never recalculate in the field.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Section factor and heating of protected steel"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
從鋼構深化圖取出每一斷面尺寸，依三面或四面受火計算受熱周長與斷面係數，與廠商厚度表或試驗登錄的適用範圍比對。
防火塗料只在火災時發揮作用，平時不需要檢查與維護。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

quiz.explanation: 從鋼構深化圖取出每一斷面尺寸，依三面或四面受火計算受熱周長與斷面係數，與廠商厚度表或試驗登錄的適用範圍比對；超出範圍（斷面係數過大或過小）時不可外插，須取得廠商或試驗機構出具的工程判定書。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take each section's dimensions from the steel shop drawings, compute heated perimeter and section factor for three- or four-sided exposure, and compare with the range of the manufacturer's thickness tables or the test listing; outside that range, with a section factor too high or too low, do not extrapolate but obtain an engineering judgement from the manufacturer or test body. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Section factor and heating of protected steel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斷面係數 Ap/V」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Section factor Ap/V” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把四面受火周長套用到頂部有樓板的梁，或把箱形柱當成 H 型鋼計算，斷面係數算錯會直接造成厚度不足或浪費；另一常見錯誤是忽略蜂巢梁與腹板開孔梁的薄腹板，局部升溫遠快於翼板。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a four-sided perimeter for a beam under a slab, or treating a box column as an H-section, gives a wrong section factor and directly produces too little or wasted thickness; another common error ignores the thin webs of cellular or castellated beams, which heat much faster locally than the flanges. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：三面受火（上方為樓板）與四面受火的周長不同，必須依實際構造計算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Three-sided exposure under a slab and four-sided exposure give different perimeters and must follow the actual construction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「被覆厚度只依耐火時效決定，與鋼構件斷面大小無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Protection thickness depends only on the required rating, not on the size of the steel section." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把四面受火周長套用到頂部有樓板的梁，或把箱形柱當成 H 型鋼計算，斷面係數算錯會直接造成厚度不足或浪費；另一常見錯誤是忽略蜂巢梁與腹板開孔梁的薄腹板，局部升溫遠快於翼板。
knowledge.textEn: Using a four-sided perimeter for a beam under a slab, or treating a box column as an H-section, gives a wrong section factor and directly produces too little or wasted thickness; another common error ignores the thin webs of cellular or castellated beams, which heat much faster locally than the flanges.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斷面係數與受保護鋼材升溫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Section factor and heating of protected steel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
噴覆材料越輕越隔熱，因此任何場所都應選用最低密度的產品。
把四面受火周長套用到頂部有樓板的梁，或把箱形柱當成 H 型鋼計算，斷面係數算錯會直接造成厚度不足或浪費。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Lighter fireproofing always insulates better, so the lowest-density product suits every location.
Using a four-sided perimeter for a beam under a slab, or treating a box column as an H-section, gives a wrong section factor and directly produces too little or wasted thickness.
quiz.explanation: 把四面受火周長套用到頂部有樓板的梁，或把箱形柱當成 H 型鋼計算，斷面係數算錯會直接造成厚度不足或浪費；另一常見錯誤是忽略蜂巢梁與腹板開孔梁的薄腹板，局部升溫遠快於翼板。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a four-sided perimeter for a beam under a slab, or treating a box column as an H-section, gives a wrong section factor and directly produces too little or wasted thickness; another common error ignores the thin webs of cellular or castellated beams, which heat much faster locally than the flanges. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
